list.title: Releases
list.description: Track release lifecycle, the latest immutable candidate, and its server-evaluated readiness.
list.emptyDescription: Create a release to register immutable candidates and evaluate readiness.
list.noFilteredDescription: No releases have this lifecycle state.

create.title: Create release
create.description: Define the release identity and delivery context. A release starts in draft state.
create.readOnlyDescription: Only workspace owners, administrators, and leads can create releases.
create.basicsDescription: Use a stable key that automation and people can reference.
create.keyHint: Letters, numbers, periods, underscores, and hyphens; for example 2026.08.1.
create.keyInvalid: Enter a valid release key up to 50 characters.
create.name: Release name
create.nameInvalid: Enter a release name up to 200 characters.
create.contextDescription: Environment and target date are optional and can be omitted when they are not known yet.
create.environmentHint: Only active environments can receive new releases.
create.noEnvironments: No active environments are configured. You can still create the release without one.
create.targetDateHint: The intended delivery date, not a readiness decision.
create.externalReferenceHint: Optional issue, planning document, or external system reference.
create.externalReferenceInvalid: Keep the external reference under 2,048 characters.

detail.noCandidatesDescription: Register a build or source revision before evaluating readiness.
detail.noLinkedRuns: No test runs are linked to this candidate.
detail.noAvailableRuns: All available test runs are already linked.
detail.unlinkConfirmMessage: This test run will no longer contribute evidence to this candidate's readiness.

confirm.activateMessage: The release will move from draft to active. Candidates can still be registered while it is active.
confirm.releaseMessage: This finalizes the release. Candidates and test-run links can no longer change.
confirm.cancelMessage: Cancellation is final. Candidates and test-run links can no longer change.

candidateCreate.title: Register candidate
candidateCreate.description: Capture an immutable build identity. Later evidence and readiness decisions refer to this exact candidate.
candidateCreate.unavailableDescription: Only owners, administrators, and leads can register candidates while a release is draft or active.
candidateCreate.identityDescription: Provide at least one stable identity value. Caselog normalizes it before enforcing project-wide uniqueness.
candidateCreate.identityRequired: Enter a source revision, build identifier, or artifact digest.
candidateCreate.revisionHint: For example, a Git commit SHA.
candidateCreate.buildHint: For example, a CI build number or pipeline identifier.
candidateCreate.digestHint: For example, a container or package SHA-256 digest.
candidateCreate.metadataDescription: Optional context helps people trace the candidate without changing its identity.
candidateCreate.sourceUrlHint: Optional link to the commit, build, or artifact.
candidateCreate.sourceUrlInvalid: Enter a valid absolute URL up to 2,048 characters.
